title: Dispatch: kn38 (Sonnet 5.5, attempt 1)
description:
Implementation plan for parent eshyra-kn38 (bd show eshyra-kn38). Supervisor decisions below are made; STOP and record in notes if the code contradicts a premise.

WORKTREE/BRANCH: .worktrees/eshyra-kn38.1 on branch eshyra-kn38.1 (cut from origin/main). Deps installed.
FILE BOUNDARY: a parallel task edits packages/core/src/state/usageCounters.ts, packages/core/src/state/rest.ts, packages/core/test/usageCounters.test.ts, packages/core/test/rest.test.ts. Do not edit those.

CODE SURVEY
- packages/core/src/character/spellPreparation.ts alwaysPreparedFor(sheet, resolver) (~line 93): subclass spellTableRefs -> subclassSpellGrants rows with level <= sheet.level -> resolveSpell; Circle of the Land picks the table by the recorded land featureChoice, else returns `unresolved`; throws SpellPreparationError on an unresolvable name. NOT gated by caster kind (the long-rest operation gates prepared casters earlier).
- packages/core/src/character/levelUpEngine.ts: computeLevelUpChangeSet (~line 603, spellSelections ~616) builds the pure change set; applyChangeSetToSheet (~1580) writes spellcasting/spells only when changeSet.spellSelections is present.
- packages/core/src/character/finalizeCharacter.ts spellState (~line 723) builds the creation spellcasting buckets; classFeatureState sets sheet.subclass from creation picks (eshyra-nnj6).
- CharacterSpellcasting.alwaysPrepared (finalizeCharacter.ts) is included in spellsUnion and preserved by applySpellPlacements.
- Pack: subclass:life-domain (cleric L1 domain spells bless, cure wounds), subclass:oath-of-devotion (paladin 3/5/9/13/17), subclass:circle-of-the-land (land tables 3/5/7/9), subclass:fiend (warlock EXPANDED spell list: NOT always-prepared).

DECISIONS
1. Export a pure helper from spellPreparation.ts (e.g. computeAlwaysPrepared(sheetLike{subclass, level, featureChoices}, classRecord, resolver)) that returns {refs, unresolved?} and is gated: only classes whose spellPreparation.kind is 'prepared' get refs; every other class returns {refs: []} (so the warlock fiend expanded list is never treated as always prepared). The long-rest operation uses the same helper. Unresolvable spell name still fails closed (at level-up raise LevelUpEngineError, at creation a finalize error).
2. Level-up: computeLevelUpChangeSet computes alwaysPrepared at the TARGET level with the subclass the sheet will have after this level-up (a subclass chosen in this very level-up counts) and the resulting featureChoices (a land pick made this level counts). Add `alwaysPrepared?: LevelUpDelta<readonly string[]>` to LevelUpChangeSet when the list changes. applyChangeSetToSheet writes spellcasting.alwaysPrepared and recomputes spells = spellsUnion even when spellSelections is absent (create the spellcasting object from effectiveSpellcasting/base if needed; never drop existing buckets). Any ref that becomes always-prepared is removed from spellcasting.prepared (it no longer counts against the limit); record those removals in the change set. `unresolved` (Circle of the Land with no land pick) does not block level-up: leave circle spells absent.
3. Creation: finalize writes alwaysPrepared for a level-1 prepared caster with a subclass (Life Domain cleric -> bless, cure wounds) and removes them from prepared if the player also picked them; spells = spellsUnion.
4. No change to the long-rest operation's gate or rules beyond using the shared helper.

EVIDENCE (real pack, concise)
- Creation: finalized Life Domain cleric has alwaysPrepared [spell:bless, spell:cure-wounds], present in sheet.spells, and not in prepared even if picked.
- Level-up: Life cleric 2->3 adds lesser restoration + spiritual weapon to alwaysPrepared with no spell choice made; change set records the delta; ledger appliedChanges carries it.
- Paladin choosing Oath of Devotion at 2->3 gets protection from evil and good + sanctuary in the same level-up.
- Fiend warlock level-up: no alwaysPrepared.
- Druid Circle of the Land without a land pick: level-up succeeds, no circle spells.

PROTOCOL: run `npm run verify:worktree` from the worktree root BEFORE committing (it rewrites files); commit on eshyra-kn38.1; append a completion report with `bd update eshyra-kn38.1 --append-notes`; file follow-ups with bd create; `bd close eshyra-kn38.1`.
notes: Done on branch eshyra-kn38.1. Unresolvable grants fail closed (LevelUpEngineError / finalize invariant). Tests added for Life cleric creation + 2->3, paladin Devotion at 3, Fiend none, Circle w/o land; 3 existing tests updated (domain spells now leave prepared). verify:worktree green.
